name: Crossbeam
description: Connect your Claude workspace to Crossbeam and bring Ecosystem Intelligence into every AI workflow. The Crossbeam MCP Server lets Claude securely access your partner and account data — surfacing overlaps, partner activity, and warm paths directly in chat. Use it to enrich AI responses with real-time ecosystem context, power smarter prioritization, and uncover co-sell opportunities without leaving your conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Crossbeam to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Crossbeam to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.crossbeam.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Crossbeam MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Crossbeam lists 14 MCP tools, including find_overlapping_accounts_and_leads, find_overlapping_partners, get_account_context, get_partner_context, get_ecosystem_activity, find_partner_recommendations, find_partner_shared_contacts, get_partner_suggestions, search_crossbeam_knowledge, get_overlap_list_link, get_ecosystem_list_link, and get_deal_navigator_close_deals_link.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Crossbeam?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Crossbeam in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Crossbeam requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Crossbeam is developed by Crossbeam. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
